text:
Practice: auto-check or Verify; Missed means latest evaluated attempt was incorrect. Statistics expands inline; no separate Associated text or Commented key. Settings only in footer; no avatar popover.
Mocks: leave blanks and revisit/change answers subject to verified exam rules. Leaving pauses the timer; timeout submits recorded answers.
Open: filter chips / automatic application, Subject–Topic dependency, refresh, link destinations, setup/history, scoring and restoration.
